test_GroupedBatchSampler_respect_order: test the GroupedBatchSampler to verify it respects the original sample order when batching by group
test_GroupedBatchSampler_drop_uneven: test the GroupedBatchSampler with drop_uneven enabled to drop incomplete batches at group boundaries
test_SubsetSampler_with_GroupedBatchSamp: test the SubsetSampler combined with GroupedBatchSampler to batch a subset of indices by group
test_IterationBasedBatchSampler_num_iter: test the IterationBasedBatchSampler to verify it yields the exact number of iterations specified
create_SubsetSampler_class: create a SubsetSampler class that iterates over a fixed list of dataset indices
